Fennec portal sounds

New sounds for the portal kit, built from recorded sounds. Every gate shares one motif (a glassy snap, a sci-fi liquid hit, a deep electric hum). These are new, so there is no stand-in to compare. The game's current fennec sounds belong to the old sand and ears kit and are untouched. Say "all good", or name the ones to redo.
